name: Center-Coordinate Kinematic Isomorphism
description: Translates the 1D interval scheduling constraints into kinematic constraints on the center coordinates of sliders. The non-overlap constraint is obfuscated as a quadratic lower bound on the distance between centers, and the sequencing constraint is expressed as a relative distance bound. This forces models to algebraically decode the constraints to recognize the underlying sum-of-lengths bottleneck, breaking surface-level pattern matching.
